newsitem.title: USA: Affymetrix target of Hyseq patent suit.
newsitem.headline: Affymetrix target of Hyseq patent suit.

text.p: Affymetrix Inc said early Tuesday that a company called Hyseq Inc has filed a patent infringement suit against it in the Federal District Court for the Northern District of California.

Affymetrix said the suit claims it uses Hyseq's version of a technique called "sequencing by hybridization" that is claimed in two U.S. patents and is issued to two people based on work done at the Institute for Molecular Genetics in Yugoslavia.

"We have heard these allegations third hand over several years. Accordingly, we have taken time to study the patents and we look forward to proving that these allegations are false," Affymetrix said in a release.
